entity.summary: Australian centralized digital asset exchange operated by ACCE Australia Pty Ltd under the Mine Digital business name from 2019 until ACCE entered administration in September 2022.
entity.notes: ASIC states that ACCE Australia Pty Ltd operated the Mine Digital digital-asset exchange between May 2019 and September 2022. The Australian Business Register records Mine Digital as ACCE Australia's business name from 2019-05-27, but that registration date is not treated as an exact public exchange launch date. HEI therefore leaves launch_date null. ACCE entered administration on 2022-09-23 and a liquidator was appointed on 2022-12-01; HEI uses the administration date as the terminal insolvency marker while not claiming it was the exact last trading timestamp. AUSTRAC later cancelled ACCE Australia's digital-currency-exchange registration on 2023-07-10. Mine Digital acquired GBX in January 2021, but no predecessor/successor lineage edge is created because the GBX brand and platform were closed rather than continued as the same exchange identity. ASIC's fraud charge against the former CEO is an allegation against an individual transaction and is not converted into a scam_rug classification for the exchange entity.

events.title: Mine Digital acquired Global Blockchain Exchange
events.description: GSX Group completed the sale of Global Blockchain Exchange to Mine Digital; the GBX-DAX closed and customer balances were transferred into the Mine Digital transition process.
events.notes: This records Mine Digital as the acquiring venue. It does not create a predecessor/successor edge because Mine Digital did not continue the GBX brand or platform technology.

events.title: ACCE Australia entered administration
events.description: ACCE Australia Pty Ltd, operator of Mine Digital, entered administration after having operated the exchange through September 2022.
events.notes: ASIC gives 2022-09-23 as the administration date and states Mine Digital operated from May 2019 to September 2022. HEI uses this as the terminal insolvency marker, not as an asserted exact last trade time.

events.title: AUSTRAC cancelled ACCE Australia's digital-currency-exchange registration
events.description: AUSTRAC recorded cancellation of ACCE Australia Pty Ltd's digital-currency-exchange registration on 2023-07-10.
events.notes: The cancellation occurred after the 2022 administration and liquidation process; it is preserved as a later regulatory lifecycle event rather than a second death marker.

evidence.title: Global Blockchain Exchange completes sale process to Mine Digital
evidence.notes: First-party completion notice confirms that Mine Digital acquired GBX and that the GBX-DAX closed with customer balances transferred into the Mine Digital transition process.

evidence.title: Ex CEO of crypto exchange Mine Digital charged with fraud
evidence.notes: ASIC states ACCE Australia operated Mine Digital between May 2019 and September 2022, entered administration on 2022-09-23, and had a liquidator appointed on 2022-12-01. The fraud allegation itself is not used to classify Mine Digital as a scam.

evidence.title: Virtual asset registration actions
evidence.notes: Current AUSTRAC action register lists ACCE Australia Pty Ltd, ACN 627188318 / ABN 52627188318, with registration cancellation on 2023-07-10.

evidence.title: Historical details for ABN 52 627 188 318
evidence.notes: ABN Lookup identifies ACCE Australia Pty Ltd and records Mine Digital as its business name from 2019-05-27. HEI uses this for legal/entity identity and Australia origin, not as an exact public exchange launch date.
